_comment: Bands = usage % thresholds that inject a context message when a window first crosses each band (per reset window, de-duped). Directives are keyed by band string, separately for session (5h) and weekly (7d). A crossed band uses the directive defined at the HIGHEST directive-band <= it, so the stop threshold is set entirely by which band you put the directive on here - no need to edit the hook script. Any directive containing the token @@AUTORESUME@@ triggers the pause+auto-resume wiring: the hook computes a RESUME TARGET = that window's reset + 1 min and emits a ready-to-run background sleep (Bash run_in_background) that re-invokes the model when the window reopens. Bands with no directive are report-only.

session_directives.95: SESSION LIMIT CRITICAL (5h window >=95%). Immediately STOP and PAUSE ALL work: call TaskStop on every running agent/subagent/workflow/background task, start nothing new, finish nothing new. Write a one-line handoff of what was in progress. Then arm a ONE-TIME automatic resume using the RESUME TARGET below (background sleep, NOT CronCreate) that re-invokes you when the window reopens to resume the paused work from the handoff. After arming it, tell the user and go idle. @@AUTORESUME@@

weekly_directives.99: WEEKLY LIMIT CRITICAL (7d window >=99%). Immediately STOP and PAUSE ALL work: call TaskStop on every running agent/subagent/workflow/background task, start nothing new, finish nothing new. Write a one-line handoff of what was in progress. Then arm a ONE-TIME automatic resume using the RESUME TARGET below (background sleep, NOT CronCreate) that re-invokes you when the window reopens to resume the paused work from the handoff. After arming it, tell the user and go idle. Note: a 7-day wait is too long for a background sleep to survive - for weekly, prefer pausing and resuming manually. @@AUTORESUME@@
